document: SARS Budget2026 Tax Guide hosted by National Treasury
reviewed: Relevant first-page personal income tax, rebates/thresholds, tax-free investments, retirement deductions, medical credits and donations sections read; first-page table and figures visually checked against PDF.

findings.taxFreeInvestments: Published guide statesR46,000 per tax year; receipts/accruals exempt from income tax including capital gains
findings.retirementDeduction: Conditional percentage and monetary limits stated; no blanket unlimited deduction
findings.medicalScheme: Tax credit/rebate rather than reduction of taxable income
findings.donations: Certain public benefit organisations and limits, not every registered charity

limits: This is a published2026/27 budget summary, not a full consolidated-law or subsequent-amendment review.
It does not establish every lifetime limit, eligibility/ownership condition, tax-return obligation, GAAR rule or retirement withdrawal rule.
A2026tax-year claim may mean2025/26; do not relabel this2026/27 document as evidence for an earlier year.
